decision: Proceed with a connected moving-home budget, quotes and timeline workbook plus companion worksheets selected from declared move-planning needs.
audience_hypothesis: Renters, homeowners and families coordinating a move who need costs, service quotes and deadlines in one place.
method: Manual public listing-page review via search results. Prices and listing features are observed snapshots, not proof of sales or demand. No competitor text, images, spreadsheet or layout was copied.
uncertainties: Search visibility does not establish conversion or current sales volume.
Displayed prices may include temporary discounts and can change.
The proposed EUR launch price follows the factory low-price test policy, not an estimate of product value.
